neighbours.label: an emphatic negative with a minimal unit (never once, not one, not a single, 그 어떤 ... 도, ni ... ni), as opposed to the same sentences stating a plain amount
fire: We lived there for years and never once locked the door.
He did not say one word. Not one.
I have never, even once, seen her late.
그 어떤 책도 도서관에 남아 있지 않습니다.
لا تجد في كلامهم دليلا واحدا على ذلك.
Not a single student came to the talk.
No dijo ni una sola palabra en toda la noche.
Nobody offered her so much as a glass of water.
quiet: We lived there for years and sometimes locked the door.
He said one word to me. Then two.
I have seen her late on Mondays.
تجد في كلامهم أدلة كثيرة على ذلك.
A single student came to the talk.
Dijo una palabra en la noche.
Everybody offered her a glass of water.

short: emphatic negative: never once, not one
notes: 'Not the faintest spark' scored 0.12 in a probe, though the card has 'the faintest'.
